item.title: Review: Inside Netflix’s Fight to Keep the Streaming Crown
item.description: Emily Chang travels to Paris, Seoul and Los Angeles to explore Netflix's next chapter in the entertainment world. In conversations with Co-CEO Ted Sarandos and Hollywood stars Ben Affleck and Lily Collins, Chang probes the company's global strategy, AI ambitions and executive shakeups. (Source: Bloomberg)
